Home/Yankı

Open-source engine (MIT) & live edge sandbox

Deterministic quote-grounding and live reflection.

Yankı combines a zero-retention bilingual reflection companion at the edge with an open-source Python verification engine (yanki 0.2.0) that enforces index-preserving Turkish/English quote provenance, pre-inference crisis gating, and multi-source RAG citation audits.

Live zero-retention sandbox

01 · Pre-inference deterministic safety gate

Before any network call to an LLM, normalized Turkish and English crisis rules execute locally in sub-millisecond code and short-circuit high-risk inputs safely.

02 · Strict JSON & reasoning-tag parser

Claude (edge) or vLLM/SGLang (cluster) generates a bounded JSON reflection; reasoning <think> blocks and malformed schemas fail closed instead of leaking raw model output.

03 · Character-exact quote provenance

The quoted phrase ('alinti') must match a contiguous character span in your original passage under index-preserving Unicode folding—paraphrased or fabricated quotes are stripped.

Yankı is a reflective companion and verification showcase. It is not therapy, diagnosis or medical advice, and is not an emergency service. High-risk crisis wording short-circuits deterministically before any LLM call; if you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services (112 in Türkiye).

yankıv0.2.0 · Live beta

Processed transiently via Cloudflare Workers + Anthropic API; no journal database is stored. Avoid sharing identifying or sensitive personal records. Privacy ↗

Edge API contract & runtime metadata

The live edge sandbox runs on Cloudflare Workers, executing a deterministic crisis rule check before calling the Anthropic Messages API (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) and verifying the returned JSON quote span against your input.

POST /api/reflect · {"text": "…", "lang": "en|tr"} · 8–600 characters

Request and daily usage limits apply. The interface shows an error when the service is unavailable. · Service metadata (/api/health)

Open-source verification architecture · MIT

Inside the yanki 0.2.0 Python package.

The same verification logic behind the live sandbox ships as a standalone, dependency-free Python package (`src/yanki/`) for production RAG pipelines, CI gates and multi-GPU evaluation clusters.

01 · yanki.normalize

Index-preserving Unicode folding

1-to-1 codepoint folding for Turkish `İ/ı` and diacritics (`ğ, ü, ş, ö, ç`) with exact source offset arrays so normalized substring hits slice cleanly into raw documents.

02 · yanki.grounding

Single- & multi-source RAG citation audit

`verify_quote_grounding` and `verify_multi_source_citations` validate every model quote against retrieved chunk IDs, returning `[start_char, end_char)` provenance or stripping hallucinations.

03 · yanki.guardrails & schema

Pre-inference safety & <think>-aware JSON

Deterministic sub-millisecond crisis short-circuit before LLM invocation, paired with strict typed JSON extraction that strips reasoning `<think>...</think>` traces safely.

04 · yanki.providers & hpc/

vLLM, SGLang, Claude & Slurm harness

Unified zero-SDK client across OpenAI-compatible GPU servers (`vLLM`, `SGLang`) and Anthropic Messages API, shipped with `Apptainer` CUDA recipes and `Slurm` batch scripts.

Reproducible benchmark suite

24/24 deterministic test cases across Turkish & English.

Executed on every commit in GitHub Actions CI across Python 3.11 and 3.12 (`python -m yanki.eval --offline --strict-thresholds`).
